title: Placement Hub - Phase 1 Final Mock Placement Test
description: Final Phase 1 assessment covering quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, data interpretation, critical thinking, and workplace decision making.

questions.question: A company has 800 employees. 45% work in technical departments, and 30% of those technical employees work on Project A. How many employees work on Project A?
A candidate travels 240 km to attend an interview. The first 120 km is covered at 60 km/h and the remaining 120 km at 40 km/h. What is the total travel time?

A project team of 6 members has an average experience of 4 years. When the team leader is included, the average experience of 7 people becomes 5 years. How many years of experience does the team leader have?
A product originally costs ₹2,000. Its price is increased by 15% and then a discount of 10% is given on the increased price. What is the final selling price?
The number of students placed from four departments is: CSE = 80, ECE = 60, EEE = 40 and MECH = 20. What percentage of the total placements came from CSE and ECE together?
Five students A, B, C, D and E are standing in a line. E is ahead of A. A is ahead of B. B is ahead of D. D is ahead of C. Who is definitely at the extreme front?
Four presentations P, Q, R and S are scheduled from Monday to Thursday. P must be before R. Q cannot be on Monday. S must be immediately after Q. Which schedule is possible?
options: Monday Q, Tuesday S, Wednesday P, Thursday R
Monday P, Tuesday Q, Wednesday S, Thursday R
Monday R, Tuesday Q, Wednesday S, Thursday P
Monday S, Tuesday Q, Wednesday P, Thursday R

questions.question: Priya is the sister of Rahul. Rahul is the father of Kiran. How is Priya related to Kiran?
Statements: All managers are employees. Some employees are developers. Which conclusion definitely follows?
Question: Is N greater than M? Statement I: N is greater than P. Statement II: P is greater than M. Which conclusion can be drawn?

Read the passage: 'Many companies evaluate candidates not only on technical knowledge but also on communication, teamwork and the ability to solve unfamiliar problems. A candidate who knows a programming language but cannot explain a solution clearly may struggle in a collaborative workplace.' What is the main idea?
options: Programming languages are no longer important.
Technical knowledge alone may not be sufficient for workplace success.
Companies should hire only candidates with strong communication skills.
Teamwork is more important than technical knowledge.

questions.question: Arrange the following sentences in the most logical order: P. The team identified the root cause. Q. The application started producing errors. R. The team tested the fix. S. The issue was resolved.
Choose the word closest in meaning to 'pragmatic'.
Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: Each candidate are required to bring an identity card.
Each candidate is required to bring an identity card.
Each candidates is required to bring an identity card.
Each candidate were required to bring an identity card.

questions.question: Choose the best completion: 'Despite facing several technical difficulties, the team ____.'
options: managed to complete the project on time

questions.question: You are working on a team project and notice that one teammate is repeatedly missing assigned tasks. What should you do first?
options: Complain about the teammate to everyone.
Complete all of their work without discussion.
Talk to the teammate privately and understand whether there is a problem.
Remove the teammate from the project immediately.

questions.question: During an interview, you are asked a technical question you do not know. Which response is most professional?
options: Say you do not know the exact answer but explain the related concept you understand.
Tell the interviewer that the question is irrelevant.
Remain silent until the interviewer changes the question.

questions.question: Your team has three tasks due today: a critical production bug, a routine documentation update, and a low-priority design improvement. What should be handled first?
A client requests an additional feature two days before the project deadline. What is the best first action?
options: Understand the requirement and assess its effect on time, cost and existing functionality.
Ask another team to handle it without informing the project manager.

questions.question: During a group discussion, another candidate presents an idea different from yours. What is the strongest response?
options: Interrupt and prove that your idea is better.
Acknowledge the idea, evaluate its advantages, and respectfully explain your alternative.
Wait until the discussion ends and criticize the idea privately.
